task: Special::confluentHypergeometric(a, b, z) returns noise for negative z when b - a is a non-positive integer. M(2, 1, -100) returns about 1.17e28, but the true value is about -3.682875216260628e-42; M(2, 1, -29) returns about 9.18e-5 instead of about -7.1222638126553845e-12; M(3, 1, -20) should be about 3.318457332126078e-07. Results in this family should be accurate to about 12 significant digits across the whole negative-z range, from small |z| to z = -100. Results for z >= 0 and for other parameters must not change.
